sentinels.not_applicable: The field does not apply to this method or run state.
sentinels.not_recorded: The evidence has not yet been produced.
sentinels.missing_evidence: The evidence was required for this state but is absent.

dynamic_gating.scalar_statistics: all columns named p2/p4/p6, applied_w, entropy, dominant ratio, temperature and sample count

markdown_columns: Fixed v5 fields are followed by every non-empty authoritative CSV field in deterministic lexical order; unknown historical and future fields are never silently omitted.

candidate_binding.protocol_signature: canonical resolved configuration excluding only smoke epochs/periods/output_dir
candidate_binding.implementation_signature: Git tree excluding only recorder-managed evidence products

migration: v1-v4 schema identities, rows and unknown columns are retained; new unrecoverable fields become not_recorded and are never fabricated as v5.
